sentences.zh: Whoop还为我提供了可操作的、个性化的见解，这让我变得更有意向性，意味着我每天都能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: Hello and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎回到《二十岁的心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨二十岁时会遇到的一些重大生活变化和转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners.
sentences.zh: 新听众，老听众们。

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here back for another episode.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能回来收听新的一期节目。

sentences.en: Before we get into it, though, I firstly just want to say thank you, a huge thank you for all of the support in 2022.
sentences.zh: 不过在开始之前，我首先想说声谢谢，非常感谢大家在2022年给予的所有支持。

sentences.en: We are coming into 2023, into the new year, strong, happy and ready for so many more interesting topics and episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们正带着力量、快乐和对更多有趣话题与节目的期待，迈向2023年，迈向新的一年。

sentences.en: And there is so much to look forward to, so much.
sentences.zh: 未来有太多值得期待的事情了，真的太多了。

sentences.en: But today we're going to begin our new year by tackling, I think, one of the biggest and most underrated concepts that many of us will come across in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 但今天，我们要通过探讨一个我认为是我们在二十岁时会遇到的最大且最被低估的概念，来开启我们的新一年。

sentences.en: If you've ever struggled with feeling like you don't know yourself anymore, you've become separated from who you truly are,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经挣扎于感觉自己不再了解自己，与真实的自我产生了隔阂，

sentences.en: you change yourself depending on the people you're around, depending on your friends or your family, or you might just be feeling a little bit loSt.
sentences.zh: 或者你根据身边的人、朋友或家人而改变自己，又或者你只是感到有点迷茫，

sentences.en: This episode is for you, because today we are talking about how to embrace our authentic selves.
sentences.zh: 那么这一期节目就是为你准备的，因为今天我们要讨论如何拥抱真实的自我。

sentences.en: This is one of the most crucial things that we do need to accomplish in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在二十岁时需要完成的最关键的事情之一。

sentences.en: And although it's not easy, although it's misunderstood, the outcomes, the benefits, they're not only lifelong, but they're pretty endless.
sentences.zh: 虽然这并不容易，虽然它常被误解，但其结果和益处不仅是终身的，而且是无穷无尽的。

sentences.en: When we're able to really connect and be our true selves, be true to our values, be honest about who we are and vulnerable,
sentences.zh: 当我们能够真正连接并成为真实的自己，忠于我们的价值观，诚实地面对自己并展现脆弱时，

sentences.en: so much research, so many studies show that we are happier, we're more fulfilled, our relationships are better, and we are just, you know, overall, better versions of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 大量的研究表明，我们会更快乐，更满足，人际关系更好，而且总的来说，我们成为了更好的自己。

sentences.en: So today we are going to break down some of the essential psychology behind embodying authenticity.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们将剖析体现真实性背后的一些基本心理学。

sentences.en: We're going to discuss the true meaning of authenticity and the reasons why it is so crucial.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论真实性的真正含义以及它为何如此重要。

sentences.en: We're going to explore what happens when we become disconnected or separated from our authentic selves, and why this is happening more and more in modern day society.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨当我们与真实的自我脱节或分离时会发生什么，以及为什么这种情况在现代社会中越来越普遍。

sentences.en: And finally, of course, how do we find our way back?
sentences.zh: 最后，当然，我们该如何找回自我？

sentences.en: How do we fully embrace who we are and live through our authentic selves, through things like honesty, boundaries, generosity, and of course, self-exploration?
sentences.zh: 我们如何通过诚实、界限、慷慨以及自我探索等方式，完全拥抱并活出真实的自我？

sentences.en: There is so much to cover.
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论的内容非常多。

sentences.en: And the research, oh my gosh, the studies are fascinating.
sentences.zh: 而且研究，天哪，这些研究太迷人了。

sentences.en: I have been having such a crisis of authenticity recently, and it can be so incredibly painful, I think,
sentences.zh: 我最近也经历了一场真实性危机，我认为这真的非常痛苦，

sentences.en: to feel like the version of yourself that you are presenting to others is not who you actually are.
sentences.zh: 感觉你向他人展示的那个版本的自己，并不是真正的你。

sentences.en: There have been so many times I have changed myself for the people I'm around, for the people I'm dating, for the people I'm friends with,
sentences.zh: 我曾多次为了身边的人、约会对象或朋友而改变自己，

sentences.en: and something I've realized is that, honestly, life is too short.
sentences.zh: 但我意识到的一点是，老实说，人生苦短。

sentences.en: Life is too short to not be exactly who you are.
sentences.zh: 人生苦短，不能不活出真实的自己。

sentences.en: So let us learn and grow together and explore how it is that we can embody and embrace our authentic selves.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们一起学习、成长，探索如何体现并拥抱真实的自我。

sentences.en: As we always do, let's begin with the basics.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，让我们从基础开始。

sentences.en: Let's begin with the foundation.
sentences.zh: 让我们从根基开始。

sentences.en: So what actually is the authentic self?
sentences.zh: 那么，真实的自我到底是什么？

sentences.en: The authentic self, it's sometimes known as the true self as well, and it is a concept that's been around for a while,
sentences.zh: 真实的自我，有时也被称为真我，这是一个存在已久的概念，

sentences.en: and it's discussed back in history by people like Socrates and Freud.
sentences.zh: 早在历史上就被苏格拉底和弗洛伊德等人讨论过。

sentences.en: Although it has a long history, I would say it definitely hasn't lost its relevance in the modern day, and it remains just as important to understand,
sentences.zh: 虽然它历史悠久，但我认为它在现代绝对没有失去其相关性，理解它依然非常重要，

sentences.en: especially in our 20s when the pursuit of the authentic self I think is one of the most crucial journeys that we all have to embark on as individuals.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在我们二十岁的时候，我认为追求真实的自我是我们每个人作为个体必须踏上的最关键的旅程之一。

sentences.en: Discovering our authentic self is also really, really crucial for our well-being and our relationships, not just with others, but with ourselves as well.
sentences.zh: 发现真实的自我对于我们的幸福和人际关系也至关重要，不仅是与他人的关系，还有与我们自己的关系。

sentences.en: So if we don't have that keen awareness or that understanding of who we are or what we stand for,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们没有那种敏锐的觉知，或者对我们是谁、我们坚持什么缺乏理解，

sentences.en: I think it's one of those things where we can never actually truly be seen or understood.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们永远无法真正被看见或被理解。

sentences.en: So the depth of our relationships, the depth of our knowing of ourselves, the depth of our self-awareness is never going to be at the place that it truly needs to be.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们人际关系的深度、我们对自我的了解深度、我们自我觉知的深度，永远无法达到它真正需要的水平。

sentences.en: So essentially, our authentic self is who we are at our very core.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，真实的自我就是我们核心的那个自己。

sentences.en: When all of the distractions and the facades are gone, and when we are truly stripped back and vulnerable, that's what remains.
sentences.zh: 当所有的干扰和伪装都消失，当我们真正被剥离外壳并展现脆弱时，剩下的就是那个自我。

sentences.en: That's our authentic selves.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们真实的自我。

sentences.en: And it's the part of you that would exist regardless of others' expectations, regardless of where you are in the world or who you are with.
sentences.zh: 它是你内心深处无论外界有何期待、无论你身处何地或与谁在一起都依然存在的那个部分。

sentences.en: It's this essence, this deep essence of who you are as an individual.
sentences.zh: 它是你的本质，是你作为一个个体最深层的本质。

sentences.en: In psychology, authenticity, it's more than merely trying to be ourselves.
sentences.zh: 在心理学中，真实性不仅仅是试图做自己。

sentences.en: It requires a lot more than that.
sentences.zh: 它需要的远不止这些。

sentences.en: It requires action and truth and honesty.
sentences.zh: 它需要行动、真理和诚实。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, owning what you believe, what you desire, and your strengths and weaknesses, along with what you choose to do with all of those things.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，它意味着认可你的信仰、欲望、优点和缺点，以及你选择如何处理所有这些事情。

sentences.en: It's also not just something that we happen across.
sentences.zh: 它也不是我们偶然就能碰到的东西。

sentences.en: It can take us years, years, sometimes even decades for some people to fully embrace and discover who we are.
sentences.zh: 对于某些人来说，可能需要几年、几年，甚至几十年的时间才能完全拥抱并发现我们是谁。

sentences.en: But once we do it, I think it is one of those things that never grows out of style.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们做到了，我认为它永远不会过时。

sentences.en: It never loses its merit.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会失去其价值。

sentences.en: It's such a valuable thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常有价值的事情。

sentences.en: So our authentic selves, it's made up of a few components.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们真实的自我由几个部分组成。

sentences.en: And there is a bit of a debate about this within the discipline of psychology, about the contents of the authentic self.
sentences.zh: 在心理学领域，关于真实自我的内容存在一些争论。

sentences.en: But the main elements that tend to come up include things like our values, our beliefs, judgments, our desires, our temperament, which is a really important one.
sentences.zh: 但主要的要素通常包括我们的价值观、信仰、判断、欲望、气质（这是一个非常重要的因素），

sentences.en: And then things like our mission, our creativity, our free will.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的使命、创造力和自由意志。

sentences.en: And finally, that recognition, that feeling, that acknowledgement of being alive, of being our own person and of being in control of who we are and the actions that we take.
sentences.zh: 最后，那种认知、那种感觉、那种对活着、对成为独立个体、对掌控自己以及所采取行动的认可。

sentences.en: These are, I guess, what make up the authentic self.
sentences.zh: 我想，这些构成了真实的自我。

sentences.en: But it isn't just a list of how we would describe ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是一份关于我们如何描述自己的清单。

sentences.en: It isn't just a box of different things.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅是一个装满不同东西的盒子。

sentences.en: It's also a verb.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个动词。

sentences.en: And our authentic self requires action to realize.
sentences.zh: 真实的自我需要通过行动来实现。

sentences.en: Individuals who we would consider to live in alignment with their true self or their authentic selves,
sentences.zh: 那些我们认为活得与真我或真实自我保持一致的人，

sentences.en: they are these people who are able to recognize and accept themselves for who they truly are.
sentences.zh: 他们是能够认识并接受自己真实面貌的人。

sentences.en: That's not just the good stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是指好的一面，对吧？

sentences.en: I think often we have a tendency to characterize ourselves by the things that we're good at, or by our jobs, or by the things that we see merit in.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们往往倾向于通过我们擅长的事情、我们的工作或我们认为有价值的事情来定义自己。

sentences.en: But in order to understand our authentic selves, we also have to be able to recognize the ugly things about ourselves, the bad things, our weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 但为了理解真实的自我，我们也必须能够认识到自己丑陋的一面、糟糕的一面以及我们的弱点。

sentences.en: People who are in alignment with their authentic selves, they also strive to align their actions, what they choose to do, with their core values and their beliefs
sentences.zh: 与真实自我保持一致的人，也会努力将他们的行动、他们选择做的事情与他们的核心价值观和信仰相统一，

sentences.en: in that hope of syncing everything they do and discovering who they are in kind of tandem with everything else in their lives.
sentences.zh: 希望将他们所做的一切与发现自我同步，并与生活中的其他一切协调一致。

sentences.en: So acting in one way at all times and in alignment with their true selves.
sentences.zh: 所以，在任何时候都以一种方式行事，并与真实的自我保持一致。

sentences.en: And these are the people who we see,
sentences.zh: 这些人就是我们所看到的，

sentences.en: I'm sure some of us know them, who express themselves really freely, who act with consistency.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们中有些人认识他们，他们表达自己非常自由，行为始终如一。

sentences.en: They are the people we see and who we meet, who seem almost free from others' expectations, societal norms, but mostly they don't deny who they are
sentences.zh: 他们是我们见到和遇到的人，似乎几乎不受他人期望、社会规范的束缚，但最重要的是，他们不否认自己是谁，

sentences.en: and they don't deny who they believe they are and what they want to do with their lives and what their impact on the world will be.
sentences.zh: 也不否认他们相信自己是谁，以及他们想在生活中做什么，以及他们对世界的影响力。

sentences.en: This is because authenticity as an idea, but also as something that we embody, it almost illuminates that path forward to live the life that you want.
sentences.zh: 这是因为真实性作为一个理念，也是我们体现的东西，它几乎照亮了通往你想过的那种生活的道路。

sentences.en: When you are clear with yourself about what matters, you begin to understand how to make decisions that are going to align with your goals
sentences.zh: 当你清楚自己什么才是重要的，你就开始明白如何做出与你的目标、

sentences.en: and with your identity and your core values and you begin to build a life for yourself that does have meaning and does have joy.
sentences.zh: 与你的身份和核心价值观相一致的决定，你开始为自己建立一种有意义且充满快乐的生活。

sentences.en: And I know if this sounds a bit like, you know, new age enlightenment, I don't blame you for thinking this.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果这听起来有点像新时代的启蒙，我不怪你这么想。

sentences.en: I can understand how a lot of the words we're using sound pretty wishy-washy, but psychology as a discipline, as a scientific discipline, has shown us time and time again
sentences.zh: 我能理解我们使用的很多词听起来很空泛，但心理学作为一门科学学科，一次又一次地向我们证明，

sentences.en: that this version of us does exiSt.
sentences.zh: 这个版本的我们确实存在。

sentences.en: The authentic self does exiSt.
sentences.zh: 真实的自我确实存在。

sentences.en: And the people who are able to access it are by far some of the happiest people in the world.
sentences.zh: 而那些能够触及它的人，绝对是世界上最快乐的人之一。

sentences.en: And in contrast to all of this and the authentic self, there is also this false self, right?
sentences.zh: 与这一切和真实自我形成对比的，还有所谓的虚假自我，对吧？

sentences.en: This inauthentic self.
sentences.zh: 这种不真实的自我。

sentences.en: And that refers to almost a defensive facade or disguise that we tend to create to protect us from judgment or to conform and to be who others want us to be.
sentences.zh: 它指的是一种防御性的伪装或面具，我们倾向于创造它来保护自己免受评判，或者为了顺从并成为别人希望我们成为的样子。

sentences.en: This inauthentic self, it's viewed as doing our duty rather than acting out of desire and from a place of honesty and vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 这种不真实的自我，被视为是在履行义务，而不是出于欲望、诚实和脆弱。

sentences.en: And when people act in ways that go against or violate their true self, often there are emotional consequences that come along with that.
sentences.zh: 当人们的行为违背或违反了真实的自我时，通常会伴随情感上的后果。

sentences.en: You might experience negative feelings ranging from, you know, feeling a bit uncomfortable in a situation to feeling really guilty all the time or really shameful.
sentences.zh: 你可能会经历负面情绪，从在某种情况下感到有点不舒服，到一直感到非常内疚或羞耻。

sentences.en: Think about a time in your life when you did, when you did act in a way that you knew contradicted who you truly were at your core.
sentences.zh: 回想一下你生命中曾经做过某件事的时候，你当时就知道那违背了你内心深处真实的自己。

sentences.en: Maybe you were working a job that didn't align with your values.
sentences.zh: 也许你从事的工作与你的价值观不符。

sentences.en: You were distracting yourself or social media or acting in a way and treating others that contradicted your beliefs.
sentences.zh: 你沉迷于社交媒体，或者以一种违背你信仰的方式行事并对待他人。

sentences.en: In that moment, I think we all know this feeling, this tug in our chest, this panic, this distress, often some kind of mental reaction that indicates to us
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我想我们都知道那种感觉，胸口的拉扯感、恐慌、痛苦，通常某种心理反应会向我们暗示，

sentences.en: that something isn't quite right.
sentences.zh: 有什么地方不太对劲。

sentences.en: That feeling is in itself pretty revealing and it's something we have to learn to listen to, which is what we're going to discuss in a second.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉本身就非常具有启示性，是我们必须学会倾听的东西，这也是我们稍后要讨论的内容。

sentences.en: But I think it's also important to acknowledge that there is this kind of longstanding debate, right?
